broader_review.summary: The numeric topology evidence is strong: StreetPavement exists at X22..60/Z8..28 with top Y≈0.14, foot reached 6.53 m and vehicle 9.93 m beyond the old rectangles with physical returns (20.98 s / 43.83 s) inside one 50.8 s no-reset run, inventory parity (2770 renderers / 47 colliders) holds, prop clones match size/orientation, and all regressions pass. However, the visual scope fails. None of the four supplied frames shows the new east street as a street or the replaced east-alley junction as an opening: frame-002 and frame-007 show only a sealed pocket of flat, windowless terracotta planes (no reused facade or fence meshes, contradicting the explicit mesh-reuse instruction and reading as new primitive walls), and every camera faces a closed wall, so the through-connection is proven numerically but never visibly. frame-010's return camera is still dominated by the car's black rear slab blocking the lower-center route, frame-000's camera clips into the left building's doorway volume, and the objective HUD panel renders empty at t=17.89791 s while the mission is still live. The MISSION FAILED overlays during the outside legs are acceptable for a topology milestone given the separate passing failure-retry test, but the connection itself lacks the required readable captures.
